answer_1.quote: Speech translation aims at converting speech from one language into speech or text in another language.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates speech and text in the target language from source speech, supporting both speech-to-speech and speech-to-text translation outputs.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the translation quality, we follow the setup in ... of the ASR decoded text with respect to the reference translations.

answer_4.quote: we conduct human listening tests to collect mean opinion scores (MOS) to evaluate the naturalness of the speech output. We randomly sample 200 utterances from the test set, and each sample is rated by 8 raters on a scale of 1-5, with 1 being the worst and 5 being the best.
answer_4.guideline: Each sample is rated by 8 raters on a scale of 1-5, with 1 being the worst and 5 being the best.
